messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick announce: we've published 'Emergency Flexible Leave' & a modest travel-subsidy rule for sudden disruptions (flight cancellations, family emergency returns). Pilot period: 9 months. Doc + request form: https://intranet.redwood/people/emergency-flex-leave

Diego (Benefits): What's covered under subsidy?

Maya (People Ops): Up to $600 per incident for unavoidable costs (rebook fee, one-night hotel). Non-reimbursable: upgrades, leisure add-ons. Receipts only; submit to travel-expenses@redwood with PTO-FLEX tag.

Lina (Payroll): Advance mechanics: managers may approve up to 4 days advance pay immediately. Employees pick repayment: spread over next 4 pay periods OR one-time deduction. Intl payroll constraints: see region table in the doc.

Omar (Legal): Reminder: written consent required in jurisdictions X, Y, Z for deductions. Also added a privacy note on documentation retention.

Ravi (Eng Manager): If someone on a critical rotation asks for 4 days, do we have to deny?

Maya (People Ops): Prioritize safety & legality. If denying would harm the employee or violate law, approve and trigger the staffing fallback: 1) notify rota channel, 2) ask backup/oncall, 3) request temporary coverage via staffing-ops. We included an escalation checklist.

Ravi (Eng Manager): OK. Any guidance for longer absences tied to these events?

Maya (People Ops): >4 days requires level-2 signoff (manager + People Ops + Benefits). For long medical leaves, handle through standard leave channels. We also added optional phased-return suggestions (50% remote days first week etc.).

Diego (Benefits): Clarify eligibility: full-time employees and contractors with >6 months tenure included?

Maya (People Ops): Full-time & part-time employees included. Contractors: case-by-case; managers should escalate to People Ops. Tenure doesn't gate emergency advances.

Lina (Payroll): Note to managers: if you approve, please mark the payroll note as "PTO-FLEX APPROVED" in the form so we can process quickly.

oncall-bot: Reminder: approved absences affecting oncall must be added to the rotation 18h before start or notify eng-oncall for swap.

Maya (People Ops): We'll run a short manager Q&A next Tue 10am PT (calendar invite) and collect anonymized metrics monthly. Ping me or Omar for policy edge-cases. Thanks! :sparkles:
